transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I just... I can’t shake this feeling that everything bad that’s happened is my fault and that I’m being punished for it. It feels like a heavy cloud over me all the time, and I don't know how to make it stop.

When you say you’re being punished, does it feel like a belief you can’t shake even when others disagree, or have you heard or seen things others don’t? Also, have you had other episodes like this in the past, or is this the first time?

It is completely unshakable, and even though my daughter tries to reassure me, I am absolutely certain God is sending me these signs, though I don't see or hear things that aren't there. This is the very first time I’ve ever gone through anything like this, as I never had these punishing thoughts or felt this deep depression before my husband passed.
